buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.

3. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 4. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Gujarat State Seeds Corporation Limited payable at Gandhinagar . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Gujarat State Seeds Corporation Limited Beej Bhavan, Sector-10-A, Gandhinagar- 382010 Terms and conditions for manpower hired through outsourced agencies: - (1) For awarding outsourced contracts under Office Facility Management Service, the process will ha ve to be carried out keeping in mind the provisions of the General Administration Department's res olution dated 01.04.2010. In addition, while carrying out the outsourced manpower tender process, the provisions of Gujarat State Procurement Policy-2024 and the prescribed provisions of GeM Port al and the guidelines from time to time will have to be followed. (2) The Labour Commissioner, Gujarat State, Gandhinagar issues circulars from time to time regardin g the issuance of minimum wage rates under the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1 970, according to which the wages of skilled, semi-skilled or unskilled workers shall be fixed in suc h a manner that the minimum wage rates are maintained. Changes in these rates from time to tim e shall be made in the payment, if necessary. (3) These rates include daily basic wage and special allowance rates. Calculations like PF, ESIC etc. w ill have to be made as per the applicable rules. (4) E. S. I will have to be approved for the district in which it is applicable. (5) The contractor/outsourcing agency concerned should be registered under the applicable Providen t Fund and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952. (A copy of the approval letter should be enclosed w ith the proposal) (6) Whether the district/area is covered under the Workers' State Insurance Scheme? In areas where the area is covered under the Workers' State Insurance Act, 1948, the relevant contracting/outsou rcing agency should be registered under the Workers' State Insurance Act, 1948. (A copy of the ap

proval letter should be enclosed with the proposal.) (7) The principal employer/outsourcer of the relevant contract outsourcing agency employing more t han 50 workers should have obtained registration and license under the Contract Granting (Regula tion and Abolition) Act, 1970 and should have filed the previous year's Consolidated Annual Return (CAR), if applicable. (8) For which, a copy of the latest order of approval of the competent authority as per the Gujarat Sh ops and Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Services) Act, 2019 and the l atest amendments made therein should be enclosed. (9) Enclose a copy of the latest certificate from the competent authority regarding payment of profes sional tax as per the Gujarat State Tax on Profession, Trades, Callings and Employment Act, 1976. (10) Include a copy of the GST Registration Certificate and a copy of the GST payment. (11) Include a copy of the audit report conducted by the firm's CA and the Consolidated Annual Return - CAR for the last year. (12) In case of workers/employees engaged in other ongoing works of the concerned contract/outsourci ng agency, they should be paying EPF/ESI contribution regularly and to ensure the same, the relev ant manpower wise download of EFP Portal which will have to be uploaded from ESI/EPF Portal and submitted compulsorily. - Details including receipt of ESI/EPF contributions paid in the last one year prior to the bid and th e names of the workers/employees whose contributions have been deposited. (13) The minimum qualifications for the manpower provided by the agency shall be as follows: For Driver: · Educational Qualification: The candidate must have passed Standard 10 (Class 10). · Driving License and Experience: The candidate must possess a valid license to drive a light m otor vehicle (LMV) and have a minimum of three years of driving experience. · Age limit as per GSSCL Requitement Rules and Present Govt. Rules and Provision. For Peon: The candidate must have 9th passed (14) In addition, after giving the work order to the contractor/outsourcing agency, when the bill is subm itted by the concerned contractor/outsourcing agency, the following details will have to be submitt ed along with the bill. (a) The workers/employees employed through the contractor outsourcing agency will have to be given a salary slip for the relevant month and the salary will have to be paid directly int o the bank account of the workers/employees. (b) (b) EPF/ESI contribution collected from Gujarat State Seeds Corporation Limited, Gandhin agar has to be deposited in the EPF/ESI account of the concerned employee. A receipt of E PF/ESI contribution with the name of the manpower has to be submitted. (c) In case of making the workers/employees work more than eight hours in a day, overtime wages shall be paid at double the normal rate of wages. (d) Bonus to be paid to the workers/employees along with their monthly wages. (e) The contractor shall issue salary slips to the workers/employees on a regular basis.

(15) Duration of the service contract may be extended to 11 months beyond the initial contract duratio n (subject to satisfactory performance and mutual consent with party and Managing Director of GS SCL) (16) Geographic Presence: Office registration certificate: Yes, Registered office address proof situated i n Gujarat must be uploaded in bid document. (17) L-1 party must be pay 5% security deposit to buyers through DD in favour of the Gujarat State Se eds Corporation Limited Payable at Gandhinagar. (18) The bidder must have ISO 9001 certificate related to the work order. (19) The MSME must have participated directly in the tender and must have obtained registration unde r C.S.P.O. or NSIC or DGS&D. (20) The bidder who seeks EMD exemption must submit the valid suppo​rting document for the relevant category as per Gem GTC with the bid and must have obtained registration under C.S.P.O. or NSIC or DGS&D. (21) The Managing Director of GSSCL reserves the right to cancel the bid at any stage without any noti ce. .
